item.title: Plaza Premium opens new lounges at DFW Airport, expanding in U.S.
item.description: Plaza Premium Group will open two new airport lounges at Dallas-Fort Worth Airport, including the first Plaza Premium First location in the US, offering privacy and luxury amenities.

item.title: Texas tops energy bill anxiety, ranks 6th in affordability
item.description: Texas ranks sixth in the US for energy affordability, with an average monthly electricity bill of $176, but the state leads the nation in energy bill anxiety, according to a new study.

item.title: Pizza Inn reopens its modernized Mesquite restaurant
item.description: Pizza Inn hosted a ribbon-cutting ceremony on March 5 to debut its fully modernized restaurant in Mesquite, which features an enhanced buffet, expanded seating, and a brighter dining environment.

item.title: Dallas Lit Fest spotlights local creators & culture identity
item.description: The Dallas is Lit! Literary Festival will return from May 6-9, 2026, featuring local creators and cultural influencers, with events held across the Oak Cliff neighborhood at several locally owned businesses and venues.

item.title: Urban Italia opens near AAC with daily happy hour specials
item.description: Urban Italia offers a daily Happy Hour program featuring discounted beverages and a curated menu of small plates, led by Chef Carla Pellegrino and award-winning mixologist Yangdup Lama.

item.title: Thousands report Amazon outages: DownDetector
item.description: Thousands of users reported outages with multiple Amazon services on Thursday.

item.title: Viral baby monkey Punch takes on bullies in new video game
item.description: A seven-month-old macaque at the Ichikawa City Zoo in Japan has inspired the release of a new video game, "Zoo Fighter - Punch's Last Stand," which is inspired by his life at the facility and his story of abandonment.

item.title: FBI data flags the crime D‑FW residents are likely to face
item.description: FBI data revealed the most frequently recorded Crimes in Dallas–Fort Worth.

item.title: Severe storms Friday: Large hail, damaging winds expected
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a warning for strong to severe storms on Friday, with the potential for large hail, damaging winds, tornadoes, and flash flooding.

item.title: Six Texas school districts rank among top 20 in U.S.
item.description: Frisco Independent School District in Texas ranked third in the US, with Fort Bend, Katy, Cypress-Fairbanks, Mansfield, and Caddo Mills districts also making the top 20.
